notes.title: Huge AnnouncementーNuumonsters Hiatus is over as Dokimon Development Wraps up!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Real quick, just wanted to say here that Dokimon is live on Steam. This is the big brother to Nuumonsters. You can see a new trailer, info on the release data, and some juicy deets in the "About this game" section. Go check it out!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2019300/Dokimon/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39380378/de5216570f65fcdaf9264204b30e70919c74f419.png[/img][/url]
[b]Click the image above to learn more![/b]

I'm currently trying to work something out to give users who bought Nuumonsters a discount for Dokimon, via some sort of "Complete the Set" bundle.. or something?

I'm not sure how it works, so probably I will have to spend some time studying, but if it's possible, this is definitely something I want to do for all of you that supported me in my beginner programmer stage!


For those that don't know, Nuumonster was on hiatus for a while because I have to basically remake the game from scratch. Thus, I went off on an adventure to get better at making games.

Did you know? I made a whole engine, where you can make your own monster tamer games!
[url=https://yanako-rpgs.itch.io/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39380378/e04373356685876cfa29f1001d215d10070fa1aa.png[/img][/url]
[b]Click the image above to learn more![/b]


I made Nuumonsters in about 8 months, updated it several times, and ultimately, the source code got too out of hand (seriously.. it's a mess in there). I decided I needed time, and practice.

So I ventured off into many various projects, which I worked on while doing freelancing. This eventually led to me trying to make another monster tamer game. A real one (get this, you can actually properly switch your monsters in Dokimon!)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2019300/Dokimon/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39380378/a2156b7d90a20a7e945bb9146d0a35aa2a5d2854.png[/img][/url]
[b]Wishlist Dokimon by clicking the image above![/b]

I worked on Dokimon extremely carefully, to ensure the source code stayed manageable, unlike the hot mess Nuumonsters turned into. 

3 years later, here we are. Mere months away from release. I'm older, wiser, better at art, MUCH better at programming, and picked up a lot of various skills along the way.

I can say with confidence the Dokimon is a well put together game, a full game, and a good game.


Work will resume on Nuumonsters this year as SOON as Dokimon is launched and wrapped up. I will come back here and finish what I started.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39380378/ed953f4aea14312437fcda57bc7f4c7692a3ab48.png[/img]

Lastly, we would also like to announce that we are working hard on an update for Nuumonsters THIS MONTH, please look forward to it!

Cheers ːluvː

notes.title: Bugs Patch + Steam Achievements Fixed. Improvement of some systems
notes.content:
Hey guys!! Long time no see :D

I put the game on a big sale on a whim for Halloween, and we got wayyyy more sales than I ever could have expected!

To honor that, I came back and finally made the grueling journey I needed to to make some fixes on this game.

It's been well over a year since Nuumonsters was last updated, last time I worked on this game the Steam achievements weren't working, and then GameMaker changed how you do steam stuff.

After finally converting my project to use the new system, I was running into an error that was stopping the game from launching at all, so I've been unable to send this update out until now :(

It turned out being an issue with POWERSHELL of all things, if you can believe it!

Regardless, I'm now back older and wiser, and the game is fixed, and at this time there is no bugs or issues I am aware of.

I hope you can continue to show me your love and support you all have provided over the years of my game development^^

Now that this issue is fixed, please let me know if you find any bugs or issues! I will be able to fix anything and everything rather quickly with this hurdle finally out of the way.

I've become a significantly better programmer in the years that followed the release of this, my first game, Nuumonsters :)

I'm really looking forward to continuing the Nuumonsters journey in the near future, with my newfound abilities, please look forward to it!

notes.title: EXP Balance + Full Menu Conversion to Keyboard/Gamepad Controls (No More Mouse)
notes.content:
In this updated we finally, finally finished converting all of the menus to remove the need for using the mouse. You can now comfortably play all of the game with one hand on the keyboard, or on your gamepad without having to move around a little mouse cursor with your control stick.

We also spent a lot of time balancing out the experience system, and with some help I believe we've finally nailed it. To combat the lack of an experience sharing system, we buffed the experience gains for towards monsters in nearly all cases, but still of course, you will gain much more experience when battling trainers versus battling wild monsters.

There was also several minor fixes that went in to play, including issues with a couple of the cut scenes, rewording of some dialogue, and so on.

P.S. Achievements are working again. Sorry that they keep breaking!! The reason for this is because I keep changing computers, and because of that, Nuumonsters is no longer able to find the Steam SDK to communicate with steam achievements ;( But now that I've discovered the reason for them continuously breaking, we should be able to keep them active and functioning from here on^^

For news or questions regarding Nuumonsters, please feel free to contact us at discord at any time:
https://discord.com/invite/4YUaYNvVHD

notes.title: Dokimon + MonTamer Maker Kickstarter Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Kickstarter link:[/b]
http://kck.st/3Pnsj9p
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39380378/cdad3ac201f8edb3822e8e177bc16e53f20fe796.png[/img]

For those that have been wondering if Nuumonsters is still being worked on, the answer is yes, although, the work has been very slow as I am remaking most of what makes up the game. I started Nuumonsters 3 years ago, around the same time that I started making games full-time, and I have learned so much in these three yeas. Nuumonsters was intended to be a small game, but the interest has inspired me to make it more and more complex as I was working on it. Unfortunately, because of the transition from small, linear game, to big, complex title, the Nuumonsters source quickly got out of hand with all of the changes I had to do.

This is why I am now working on Dokimon + MonTamer Maker. MonTamer Maker allows us to very quickly make creature collector games, and it is what I would be structuring the new and evolved Nuumonsters which would also result in it's transition out of early access. MonTamer Maker started out exclusively as an engine just for rebuilding Nuumonsters with, but I later decided to to sell it along with new, to-be-made assets. Dokimon is a direct product of MonTamer Maker, and would released AFTER Nuumonsters exits early access (which is coming soon). Said assets will also influence and be used in Nuumonsters, the more art we have (and don't have to make to continue production) will further increase the speed at which Nuumonsters can be finished :)

Even to this day I have been hiring artists to work on new Nuumonsters art (nearly 15+ large monsters added last update!) and I have been working on the story, and also just recently ordered more music that will be included in the game (now in production).

I can only ask for your patience while I work with my now team (Nuumonsters started as a solo project!) to continue learning about making games and eventually create the Nuumonsters we all hope and dream for, free of bugs, intuitive features/ui, and rich with features, characters, story, events, and all the other awesome things I've come to want to add to the game. 

If anyone is interested in learning more about Dokimon and/or MonTamer Maker, please see the links below, thank you so much for your time and your patience!

Kickstarter Page:
http://kck.st/3Pnsj9p

Twitter:
https://twitter.com/yanako_rpgs

Itch.io:
https://yanako-rpgs.itch.io/

Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/4YUaYNvVHD


P.S. I apologize for the lateness of this post. I have been trying to post it almost every day for a couple of weeks but Steam wasn't allowing me to upload the required images I needed to post this :( I just tried again today 6/2/2022 and finally have been able to upload the pictures!

notes.title: Nuumonsters Early Access Rewards Update and Hot Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you so much for everyone that is supporting me in the early access release of Nuumonsters!

To celebrate, I am giving all early access players ALL 9 palettes as seen in the screenshots included with the game as well as a Nuumonsters that will be found in your party or PC upon launching the game whom will be unavailable to catch in the game until further events allow it.

Yshiro is one of my favorite monsters I have made and I think he is extremely cool so I hope that you enjoy him and his OP moveset as well!

All color palettes will also stay with early access players and will have to be unlocked in later versions of the game for those that missed the early access rewards event.

Thank you all again and I hope you enjoy! With any bugs or suggestions please visit our discord channel found on our twitter page^^
